predecessors.name: Prince-Archbishopric of Salzburg
predecessors.text: the former Prince-Archbishopric of Salzburg, ruled by Hieronymus von Colloredo, who 'formally resigned in favour of Ferdinand on 11 February 1803'

predecessors.name: Prince-Bishopric of Eichstätt
predecessors.text: parts of the former prince-bishopric of Eichstätt

predecessors.name: Prince-Bishopric of Passau
predecessors.text: parts of the former prince-bishopric of Passau

successors.name: Austrian Empire
successors.text: the former Prince-Archbishopric of Salzburg and Berchtesgaden, which 'passed to the Austrian Empire'

successors.name: Kingdom of Bavaria
successors.text: the parts of the former prince-bishoprics of Eichstätt and Passau that the Electorate held, 'annexed by Bavaria'

ledger.x: 11 February 1803: Salzburg passes from its archbishop to Archduke Ferdinand.
27 April 1803: Salzburg is raised to an Electorate.
26 December 1805: Pressburg gives Salzburg to Austria.
Pressburg, December 1805: the Eichstätt and Passau parts go to Bavaria.
26 December 1805: the Electorate of Salzburg ceases.

wars.name: War of the Third Coalition
wars.outcome: French victory; the Peace of Pressburg (26 December 1805) dissolved the Electorate of Salzburg: Salzburg and Berchtesgaden to Austria, Eichstätt and Passau parts to Bavaria, Elector Ferdinand compensated with Würzburg.

certainty.note: No page opened gives boundary lines; the added Berchtesgaden, Eichstätt and Passau parts are placed by circles.
